title: Auto Loans: Relationship Discount and Discount Limits
content:
The relationship discount on Auto Loans rewards a borrower who banks with Piedmont Crescent Bank through a qualifying checking tier. This policy also sets how that discount and the autopay discount combine.

## Granting the relationship discount

The relationship discount is granted when the loan funds, provided that on the funding date the borrower has an active checking account whose tier is one of the qualifying checking tiers. The evidence is the bank's checking records for that borrower: tier, status and the account's link to the borrower.

Once granted, the discount stays with the loan for its whole life. It is not added afterwards if a qualifying account is opened only after funding, and it is not taken away if the qualifying account closes later. Changes to autopay leave the relationship discount untouched.

## Combining discounts

The autopay discount and the relationship discount are combined by plain addition. The combined amount cannot exceed the product's combined discount limit and cannot carry the rate below the product's APR floor. Whatever part of a discount the limit or the floor cuts away is simply forfeited; it is never held back for later use.

## Clauses withdrawn from this policy

Two clauses of the original policy text have been retired and are **no longer in force**:

- the clause holding that, when autopay is cancelled and the product withdraws the autopay discount on cancellation, the rate goes up by exactly the autopay discount that had been applied; and
- the clause holding that enrolling again later restores the autopay discount.

Newer Auto Loans rules on the rate written when autopay ends, and when a loan is enrolled once more, have taken their place. They are listed here only so that the earlier wording is recognised as withdrawn.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical borrowers)

**A qualifying checking account was opened a week after the loan funded.** No relationship discount; it can only be granted at funding.

**The qualifying account was active at funding and closed a year later.** The discount remains in the loan's rate.

**Both discounts would together exceed the combined limit.** Only the limit's worth comes off the rate; the excess is lost, not banked.

superseded_clauses: When autopay is cancelled and autopay_discount_removed_on_cancel is true, the APR rises by the autopay discount actually applied
